<h1 class="home-h1">Associate Professor, Department of Economics<br><a href="https://www.economics.utoronto.ca/" target="_blank">University of Toronto</a></h1>

::: {.lead}
I am a quantitative macroeconomist. I develop and solve structural models with
household and firm heterogeneity, disciplined by microeconomic data, to study
fiscal policy, entrepreneurship, multinational production, intangible
investment, and climate policy.
:::
